name: udon-mastery
description: The compiler-boundary and cost-model layer for UdonSharp: a constraint reference verified against the U# compiler source, 16 topic files spanning instruction-level cost to Udon-GPU bridges, a 252-entry technique catalog, and a lint hook that flags non-Udon C# as it is written. Out of scope: VRChat tutorials, the SDK API index, scene setup, uploading, and the SDK component catalogue.
